summary: To the Mable who will Grace our Table I thank thee for your life I will savor your sacrifice with' each slice of the knife You lived quite nights on Ekonk Hill and I honor you for the bountiful fill #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
To the Mable
who will Grace
our Table
I thank thee for
your life

I will savor
your sacrifice with'
each slice of the
knife

You lived
quite nights
on Ekonk Hill
and I honor you
for the bountiful
fill

#smallpoems
